festivals.name: Ugadi
festivals.description: Homes are decorated with mango leaves and families share ugadi pachadi, whose contrasting flavours symbolise the experiences of life.

festivals.name: Sankranti
festivals.description: Rangoli, decorated cattle and family gatherings mark the harvest season.

festivals.name: Dree
festivals.description: The Apatani community gathers for agricultural rituals, songs and dances, offering prayers for a healthy crop.

festivals.name: Losar
festivals.description: Monpa communities welcome the new year with monastery prayers, family visits and traditional food.

festivals.name: Bohag Bihu
festivals.description: Also called Rongali Bihu, this spring celebration welcomes the Assamese New Year with Bihu dance, music and festive meals.

festivals.name: Magh Bihu
festivals.description: Community feasts and ceremonial meji bonfires celebrate the end of the harvest season.

festivals.name: Chhath Puja
festivals.description: Devotees offer prayers to the setting and rising sun at rivers and ponds, with fasting and carefully prepared offerings.

festivals.name: Sonepur Mela

festivals.name: Bastar Dussehra

festivals.name: Hareli
festivals.description: Farming communities honour agricultural tools and celebrate the green season with local games and traditions.

festivals.name: Carnival
festivals.description: Colourful floats, music and dancing fill the streets in the days leading up to Lent.

festivals.name: Shigmo
festivals.description: Folk dances, processions and elaborate floats bring Goan spring traditions into public celebrations.

festivals.name: Navratri
festivals.description: Nine nights of devotion to the goddess are celebrated with circular garba dancing and dandiya raas.

festivals.name: Uttarayan
festivals.description: Rooftops fill with kite flyers during Makar Sankranti, with festive food and colourful skies.

festivals.name: Teej
festivals.description: Songs, swings and gatherings celebrate the arrival of the monsoon and the traditions of Teej.

festivals.name: Surajkund International Crafts Mela
festivals.description: Artisans and performers gather for a major cultural fair showcasing handicrafts, folk traditions and regional food.

festivals.name: Kullu Dussehra
festivals.description: Valley deities are brought to Kullu in a gathering centred on Lord Raghunath, with processions and cultural programmes.

festivals.name: Mandi Shivratri
festivals.description: Local deities, devotees and performers gather for a celebration associated with Maha Shivratri.

festivals.name: Sarhul
festivals.description: Several Adivasi communities honour sacred groves and the flowering sal tree with rituals, music and dancing.

festivals.name: Karam
festivals.description: Community celebrations centre on the Karam tree, with songs and dances expressing hopes for wellbeing and prosperity.

festivals.name: Mysuru Dasara
festivals.description: An illuminated palace, performances and the celebrated procession make Dasara a signature Mysuru experience.

festivals.name: Ugadi
festivals.description: Families welcome the new year with prayers and bevu-bella, a mixture of neem and jaggery.

festivals.name: Onam
festivals.description: Floral pookalam designs, the onasadya feast and cultural performances celebrate the homecoming of King Mahabali.

festivals.name: Vishu

festivals.name: Bhagoria

festivals.name: Khajuraho Dance Festival

festivals.description: Ganesha idols are welcomed into homes and public pandals, with prayers, modak sweets and immersion processions.

festivals.name: Gudi Padwa
festivals.description: Families raise decorated gudis outside their homes to welcome the new year.

festivals.name: Yaoshang
festivals.description: A multiday spring celebration combines devotional traditions, local sports and thabal chongba dancing.

festivals.name: Sangai Festival
festivals.description: A tourism festival presents the state’s dance, crafts, food and cultural traditions.

festivals.name: Wangala
festivals.description: Garo communities celebrate the harvest with drumming and dancing, giving thanks to the sun deity.

festivals.name: Nongkrem Dance Festival
festivals.description: Khasi ceremonial traditions and dances express thanksgiving and prayers for prosperity.

festivals.name: Chapchar Kut

festivals.name: Mim Kut

festivals.name: Hornbill Festival

festivals.name: Moatsu

festivals.name: Raja Parba

festivals.name: Vaisakhi

festivals.name: Lohri

festivals.name: Gangaur

festivals.name: Losar

festivals.name: Losoong / Namsoong

festivals.name: Pongal

festivals.name: Tamil Puthandu
festivals.description: Temple visits, festive meals and decorated entrances welcome the Tamil New Year.

festivals.name: Bathukamma

festivals.name: Bonalu

festivals.name: Garia Puja

festivals.name: Harela

festivals.name: Phool Dei
festivals.description: Children place flowers at doorsteps to welcome spring and offer blessings for the household.

festivals.description: Flower displays and cultural activities celebrate the city’s garden heritage.
